create.name: Laurie Cameron
create.bio:
Laurie Cameron is a mindfulness teacher, coach and writer living in the Washington, DC area. She came to meditation in the mid-1990s and has stayed with the Plum Village tradition of Thich Nhat Hanh ever since, formally taking the Five Mindfulness Trainings from him in 2013. Before teaching full time she spent years in management consulting and corporate leadership, living and working in Brazil and Germany, and that background still shapes how she speaks about practice: plainly, and with an eye on ordinary working days.

She founded PurposeBlue, through which she coaches individuals, runs mindful leadership programmes and retreats, and gives keynotes. She was among the first group of teachers certified by the Search Inside Yourself Leadership Institute, the programme that began at Google, and is also trained as a Presence-Based coach. Her book The Mindful Day, published by National Geographic in 2018, sets out small practices for each part of the day, from waking to sleep. She has given a TEDx talk on compassion, offers talks at the Center for Mindful Living in DC, and now writes a weekly Substack letter, already, always, on presence, belonging and self-compassion.

books.title: The Mindful Day: Practical Ways to Find Focus, Calm, and Joy From Morning to Evening
books.author: Laurie J. Cameron
books.description: A day-shaped guide to mindfulness for busy people, walking from morning routines through work, relationships and evening with short exercises for each stage. It draws on contemplative teaching alongside neuroscience and positive psychology. Published by National Geographic in 2018.

courses.title: 50 Days To A Mindful Life
courses.description: Her Insight Timer course: fifty short daily lessons of around a quarter of an hour, moving through home, work, love and play. Each day pairs a teaching with a practice so that mindful habits build up gradually.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Leadership and Personal Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching through PurposeBlue, in person, by phone or on Zoom. It starts with a discovery stage and a written plan, then continues with regular sessions that combine practical goals with mindfulness practice; team coaching is also offered.

courses.title: Mindful Leader Programs
courses.description: Live and online programmes for organisations, built on the Search Inside Yourself approach. Groups learn attention training, self-awareness and compassion practices along with the science behind them.

free_resources.title: Laurie Cameron on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations on Insight Timer, mostly short practices for self-compassion, focus and calm through the day. Free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: already, always with Laurie Cameron
free_resources.description: Her free weekly Substack letter on presence and belonging, mixing personal stories with teachings from the Plum Village tradition and occasional audio reflections.

free_resources.title: Mindful Breathing with Compassion Meditation
free_resources.description: A ten-minute guided audio from the PurposeBlue home page that settles attention on the breath and brings in a kinder attitude towards oneself.
